summary.text: Rusty Glover is the Republican candidate for Alabama State Senate District 34, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he previously represented the district from 2006 to 2018.
A history teacher, he won the May 19, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Rusty Glover was born in Mobile, Alabama, and earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree in secondary education and a master's degree in history from the University of South Alabama.
His career experience includes working as a history teacher at Mary G. Montgomery High School.
Glover assumed office in the Alabama State Senate representing District 34 in 2006 and left office in 2018.

During the 2015 legislative session, his committee assignments included Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry; Confirmations; Governmental Affairs; Mobile County Legislation; Rules; and Finance and Taxation Education, where he was vice chair.
He ran in the 2022 Republican primary for Alabama Auditor and did not advance to the runoff.
